title: Shinailbo: deposit insurer KDIC says it did not know Yebyeol Life's contractor LK held data of expired policyholders before the hack
date_note: Date is Shinailbo's article of 26 November, the only source; the page gives the Yebyeol announcement of 16 November as background.
org: Yebyeol Life General Insurance / LK Insurance Brokerage
geo_basis: country named in the source; no city given, pin at Seoul
summary: Shinailbo reports that Yebyeol Life General Insurance announced on 16 November that a hacking incident exposed personal data handled by its contractor LK Insurance Brokerage. A Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation official told the paper it did not know in advance that LK was holding data of insured people whose contracts had expired.
plain: Shinailbo reports that a contractor of Yebyeol Life was hacked and personal data leaked. The deposit insurer told the paper it did not know the contractor still held data on expired contracts.
exec: Shinailbo reports the deposit insurer overseeing Yebyeol Life did not know its contractor kept expired policyholders' data, which raises questions about oversight of contractors.

validation.note: Only Shinailbo's article of 26 November was read; Yebyeol's own notice was not read.
